# Sell the company through an acquisition

[Overview](#overview) · [Before you start](#before-you-start) · [Steps](#steps-at-a-glance)

## Overview

When shareholders and the board choose to evaluate or pursue a company sale. An authorized closing or documented withdrawal with consideration, ownership, employee and post-close obligations reconciled.

Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.

> This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.

> Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.

## Step details

<a id="step-1"></a>

### 1. Prepare the sale objectives and readiness evidence

agent-runnable


Compile ownership, financial, customer, IP, employment and contract records and the founders' objectives. Identify missing assignments, approvals and concentration risks and link to the existing data-room process.

- Sources: [SBA close or sell your business](https://legacy.sba.gov/business-guide/manage-your-business/close-or-sell-your-business) · [SEC private secondary markets](https://www.sec.gov/resources-small-businesses/capital-raising-building-blocks/private-secondary-markets)

<a id="step-2"></a>

### 2. Appoint advisers and approve the transaction strategy

human · human approval required


The board, holders and qualified advisers assess structure, conflicts, valuation, authority and potential buyers. Set confidentiality and outreach authority and distinguish an approach or indication from a binding offer.

- Sources: [SBA close or sell your business](https://legacy.sba.gov/business-guide/manage-your-business/close-or-sell-your-business) · [SEC private secondary markets](https://www.sec.gov/resources-small-businesses/capital-raising-building-blocks/private-secondary-markets)

<a id="step-3"></a>

### 3. Review indications and authorize a letter of intent

human · human approval required


Counsel and the authorized decision makers compare price, structure, financing, exclusivity and execution risk. Negotiate and approve any preliminary commitment within its stated binding scope.

- Sources: [SBA close or sell your business](https://legacy.sba.gov/business-guide/manage-your-business/close-or-sell-your-business) · [SEC private secondary markets](https://www.sec.gov/resources-small-businesses/capital-raising-building-blocks/private-secondary-markets)

<a id="step-4"></a>

### 4. Manage diligence and the issues register

agent-runnable


Share approved materials through controlled access, reconcile requests and track commercial, tax, employment, IP and security findings. Preserve source versions and assign remediation owners rather than hiding discrepancies.

- Sources: [SBA close or sell your business](https://legacy.sba.gov/business-guide/manage-your-business/close-or-sell-your-business) · [SEC private secondary markets](https://www.sec.gov/resources-small-businesses/capital-raising-building-blocks/private-secondary-markets)

<a id="step-5"></a>

### 5. Approve definitive agreements and closing conditions

human · human approval required


Qualified advisers negotiate the actual purchase agreement, disclosures, consents, regulatory conditions and employee treatment. Obtain the required company and holder approvals before authorized parties sign.

- Sources: [SBA close or sell your business](https://legacy.sba.gov/business-guide/manage-your-business/close-or-sell-your-business) · [SEC private secondary markets](https://www.sec.gov/resources-small-businesses/capital-raising-building-blocks/private-secondary-markets)

<a id="step-6"></a>

### 6. Verify conditions and execute the closing

human · human approval required · hard to undo


Counsel and finance confirm approvals, final consideration, payment instructions and the agreed funds and document flow. Authorized people release the closing actions and retain independent evidence of settlement.

- Sources: [SBA close or sell your business](https://legacy.sba.gov/business-guide/manage-your-business/close-or-sell-your-business) · [SEC private secondary markets](https://www.sec.gov/resources-small-businesses/capital-raising-building-blocks/private-secondary-markets)

<a id="step-7"></a>

### 7. Reconcile post-close obligations and handover

agent-runnable


Match proceeds, ownership changes, payroll and tax tasks to the closing statement. Transfer only authorized access and records and track escrows, adjustments, indemnity notices and continuing employee or customer obligations.

- Verify: An authorized closing or documented withdrawal with consideration, ownership, employee and post-close obligations reconciled.
- Sources: [SBA close or sell your business](https://legacy.sba.gov/business-guide/manage-your-business/close-or-sell-your-business) · [SEC private secondary markets](https://www.sec.gov/resources-small-businesses/capital-raising-building-blocks/private-secondary-markets)
